function: Learned AP precoding and RIS phase-shift design, with threshold-based AP selection, maximizing energy efficiency of a RIS-aided cell-free massive MIMO downlink. p. 5-8
system: TDD cell-free mMIMO downlink: 8 APs with 1-10 antennas, 6 single-antenna UEs, one reflecting RIS with 4-64 elements, perfect CSI; frequency band not stated. p. 3-4, 9, 12
method: Double-layer multi-agent DDPG, reinforcement learning with centralized training and distributed execution; fuzzy-logic abstraction reduces agents; adaptive power-threshold AP selection; 200 episodes of 500 steps. p. 5-10
data_channel: Simulated channels: channel and path loss model similar to ref. [18], 1000x1000 m area, quasi-static flat block fading; no standard or measured dataset. p. 3, 9
test_conditions: 200 training episodes; EE/SE averaged over 50 independent channel realizations with trained policies; sweeps of AP power, AP antennas, RIS elements; retraining per point not stated. p. 10-12
baselines: Non-learned: ZF and WMMSE. Learned: only own variants APS-MADDPG, APFC-MADDPG, APFC-FuZ-MADDPG (no FuZ or no AP selection); no earlier published learned design simulated. p. 9, 11
metrics: Energy efficiency (bit/Joule), sum spectral efficiency (bit/s/Hz), training reward and convergence time (s). p. 5, 10-12
complexity: Order of complexity of MADDPG vs FuZ-MADDPG layers in Table II (exponential vs linear in AP number L); convergence time in seconds (FuZ 45% of MADDPG). p. 9-11
q1_support: p. 9: "We adopt the channel model and path loss model similar to [18]." Custom simulator (flat quasi-static block fading, 1000x1000 m area); no 3GPP TR 38.901/CDL/QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used, so not met.
q2_support: p. 10: "the reported EE/SE is averaged over 50 independent channel realizations using the trained policies". These are new draws of the same channel model; sweeps over AP power, antennas and RIS elements change the policy dimensions (p. 6) with no stated reuse of a trained model; Remark 1 (p. 5) mentions warm-start and fine-tuning but reports no result; not met.
q3_support: p. 9: "AP Selection With MADDPG (APS-MADDPG): The RIS-aided CF mMIMO system considers AP selection and joint precoding design with the MADDPG algorithm." Non-learned ZF and WMMSE are compared, but the learned comparators are the proposed double-layer design without FuZ or without AP selection (ablations); no earlier published learned design is simulated; not met.
q4_support: p. 9: "the computational complexity of the first and second layer networks in APS-MADDPG can be denoted". Section IV-D and Table II (p. 10) give the order of complexity of the MADDPG and FuZ-MADDPG schemes.
q5_support: p. 10: "each training curve is obtained over 200 episodes, with 500 interaction steps per episode". Training is on a custom simulated environment; no code or data link, public channel dataset or measured data is given; not met.
notes: Title and DOI on page 1 match the file. Included in area 3: the learned MADDPG agents design AP precoders and RIS phase shifts (p. 5-8); AP selection is a threshold rule on the precoding output, not learned (p. 6-7). Flags for the reviewer: (1) q3 is 0 because the learned comparators are the paper's own variants (p. 9); the plain one is called conventional MADDPG on p. 9, and if the reviewer counts it as a standard learning algorithm applied to the same problem, q3 becomes 1. (2) WMMSE appears only in the figure legends (pp. 11-12), not in the text. (3) Table I (p. 2) is a qualitative feature table, not a numerical comparison with earlier works.
